one.title: We check what you sent
one.body: A case manager confirms the records are readable and tells you if anything is missing.

two.title: A lawyer reviews the case
two.body: You get a written assessment of your route and the records still needed.

three.title: We contact you
three.body: By email first, at the address you registered with. Replies within two business days.

submitted.handler: Your case handler is {name}. Replies within two business days.

welcome.title: Welcome to your portal
welcome.body: This is your personal space for the application. Here is a short tour of the 5 things you need to know. It takes under a minute.

timeline.title: Where your case stands
timeline.body: This line shows every stage of your case, from your first answers to the citizenship decision. The highlighted point is where you are now.

checklist.title: Your to-do list
checklist.body: These are the steps still open on your side. Each one gets a tick when it is done, and the bar above shows how far along you are.

action.title: Your next step, always here
action.body: This button always takes you to the one thing to do next. Right now that is your application: about 12 minutes of questions on your family.

docs.title: Upload what you have
docs.body: Add any family records you already hold: birth or marriage certificates, old passports, letters. A phone photo is fine. Whatever is missing, we search the archives for.

account.title: Saved automatically, updates by email
account.body: Everything you enter is saved as you go, so you can stop and come back any time. We email you whenever your case moves forward.

about.title: About you
about.intro: Your details as they appear on your current passport or birth certificate.

citizenship.label: Current citizenship
citizenship.hint: List all if you hold more than one

ancestor.title: Your ancestor
ancestor.intro: The relative who left Germany or Austria. Approximate dates are fine where you are unsure.

line.title: The family line
line.intro: The chain of births and marriages that connects you to your ancestor. This is what the authorities examine most closely.

line1.label: Generation between you and them
line1.hint: Leave blank if they are your parent

nameChanges.label: Any name changes in the line
nameChanges.hint: Tell us anything you are unsure about

contact.title: How to reach you
contact.intro: Where we send your case updates and requests for records.

review.title: Review and records
review.intro: Check what you have told us, then move on to the documents.

documents.title: Send us what you already have.
documents.intro: Key records carry the case. The rest help. Anything you cannot find, we search the archives for.

file.unreadableNoName: We could not open this file
file.requested: Our team has asked for this record.

errors.rejected: <n>{name}</n>: we could not accept this file. Try another copy.

birth_certificate.title: Ancestor's birth certificate
birth_certificate.why: Establishes their citizenship at birth. The single most important record in your case.

marriage_certificates.title: Marriage certificates
marriage_certificates.why: Connects surnames across generations where a name changed.

emigration_naturalization.title: Emigration or naturalization records
emigration_naturalization.why: Shows when and how they left, and when they took a new citizenship.

persecution_proof.title: Proof of persecution or departure date
persecution_proof.why: Any record placing them outside the country after 1933: a ship manifest, a visa, an affidavit.

passport.title: Your passport
passport.why: Confirms your identity and current citizenship.

family_tree.title: Family tree or written account
family_tree.why: Your own account of the line. A handwritten note or an email is fine.

photo_id.title: Photo ID for each applicant
photo_id.why: Required for every family member included in the case.

other.title: Any other supporting record
other.why: Letters, photographs, property records, school registers.

lines.finishApplication: Finish the application first. Your documents are saved and waiting here.
lines.unreadable: One file could not be opened. Replace it, or submit now and we will ask for it during the review.
lines.allIn: Everything is in. A lawyer picks up your case once you submit.
lines.canSubmit: You can submit with what you have. We will tell you what is still needed and search the archives for the rest.

submit.hint: You can add missing records later from your portal.
submit.formats: PDF, JPG, PNG, HEIC or DOCX. Up to 20 MB per file.
submit.privacy: Held confidentially by the firm, visible only to the team on your case, and removed on request.
submit.submitted: Your application is with the firm. Documents you add here reach the team on your case straight away.
submit.error: We could not send your application. Please try again.

submitting.title: Sending your application to the firm
submitting.body: Encrypting your documents and assigning your case to a lawyer. This takes a few seconds.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: We could not load your portal. Your answers and documents are safe. Please try again in a moment.
